meta.description: Friday 5pm IST. One table per advisor: focus minutes, quiz, overdue, syllabus flag, last workshop rating. Replaces the recap document.

parameters.query:
select a.academic_advisor,
  a.name,
  coalesce(sum(d.focus_minutes), 0) as focus_min,
  round(avg(d.quiz_score) filter (where d.quiz_score is not null), 1) as quiz,
  count(t.id) filter (where t.due_on < current_date and t.completed_at is null) as overdue,
  coalesce(bool_or(r.syllabus_on_track = false), false) as behind
from alcovians a
left join daily_activity d on d.alcovian_id = a.id and d.day >= current_date - 7
left join tasks t on t.alcovian_id = a.id
left join advisor_monthly_reviews r on r.alcovian_id = a.id
  and r.month = date_trunc('month', current_date)
group by a.academic_advisor, a.name
order by a.academic_advisor, behind desc, overdue desc;
